thread:
Priya Nair: Urgent - need to push an offer for Luc (short-term infra contractor) in NL. Candidate insists on EUR invoice. Role band lookup: S2, manager proposing S3-equivalent uplift for 3 months. Proposed pay: EUR 78k annualized pro-rated -> EUR 19,500 + EUR 1,500 sign-on. Start target 2026-11-02.
Marta Chen: Why the uplift? brief rationale pls.
Priya Nair: Niche LLM-serving ops skillset, zero ramp, immediate impact on inference latency. Market in NL ~S3 for this profile, short fixed term.
Lars Becker: Geo uplift >10% requires director approval. Need cost_center, budget_owner, and total cash outflow. Also confirm payroll vehicle: EoR or vendor invoice.
Priya Nair: cost_center: ENG-ML-118, budget_owner: Marta Chen, total cash EUR 21,000 (pro-rated + sign-on). Candidate prefers invoice; manager ok with EoR if net matches.
Tom Briggs: If invoice, supplier onboarding + VAT docs needed. EoR preferred for compliance and faster payroll. I'll need an approval ticket to track. Ping offers-bot.
offers-bot: Approval request created: APP-9944. Routing: people-ops -> finance -> legal. Link: https://redwood.in/offers/APP-9944
Marta Chen: I pasted the market rationale into APP-9944: "short-term MLOps infra expertise; immediate production uplift; market rates ~S3. Fixed 3-month term."
offers-bot: APP-9944 routed to Finance at 3245678925.
Lars Becker: Provisional finance OK for EUR 21,000. Approve pending confirmation of payroll vehicle and supplier docs if invoiced. Director sign-off required for uplift; I will loop in director.
legal-bot: Legal flag: NL contractor status checks required; recommend EoR to reduce misclassification risk. If invoice used, include IP assignment, deliverables, and 90-day conversion clause. Also include sign-on clawback if conversion doesn't happen (if manager requested bridging pay).
Priya Nair: No benefits for contractors; we'll add the 90-day conversion clause and sign-on clawback. Manager wants People Ops to send the centralized offer once cleared.
Tom Briggs: Director approved provisional uplift at 3245678954. Final pending legal confirmation of EoR vs supplier onboarding. :white_check_mark:
offers-bot: APP-9944 status: routed to Legal at 3245678958.
legal-bot: Legal cleared EoR route and agreed language. If candidate insists on vendor invoice, require supplier onboarding before pay.
Marta Chen: Sounds good. People Ops - please prepare offer letter with EoR gross EUR equivalent, include IP clause, 90-day conversion note, sign-on clawback, start 2026-11-02, 48h decision window.
Priya Nair: Will draft and send after final payroll confirmation. offers-bot: APP-9944 closed: Offer cleared to send at 3245678962.
